from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference/play/users/u076/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    full_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    full_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    boundary = grid[full_rows[0]][0] if full_rows else grid[0][full_cols[0]]
    row_edges = [-1] + full_rows + [h]
    col_edges = [-1] + full_cols + [w]
    from collections import Counter
    colors = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != boundary)
    background = colors.most_common(1)[0][0]
    marker = next((v for v in colors if v != background), None)
    out = []
    for ri in range(len(row_edges)-1):
        r0, r1 = row_edges[ri]+1, row_edges[ri+1]
        outrow = []
        for ci in range(len(col_edges)-1):
            c0, c1 = col_edges[ci]+1, col_edges[ci+1]
            count = sum(grid[r][c] == marker for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)) if marker is not None else 0
            outrow.append(1 if count >= 2 else background)
        out.append(outrow)
    return out
'''
path=program_dir/'task-efc51e9f.py'
path.write_text(code)
ns={}
exec(compile(code,str(path),'exec'),ns)
